checks.evidence: run_authorized_comparison calls unchanged runner.admission before freeze reconstruction, input-file verification, ledger mutation, loader import/call or replay. Existing scope owner, explicit allocation and exact RESERVED identity are required.

Every data-eligible common segment appears in both prepared bindings. Each has CONTEXT then VALIDATION windows and an independent unchanged runner._replay account. Existing _eligible excludes CONTEXT/TRAIN from entry admission. These are independent validation segments, not recreated original rolling windows. No account NAV is concatenated or summed.

segment_inputs checks exact symbol set, source symbol, LAST_PRICE basis and source BAR_CLOSE availability equality; adapt_segment_details verifies contract hash, eligible segment and complete clock coverage. It does not fill physical missing minutes or relabel delayed availability.

STARTED precedes data loading and replay. Caught failure records FAILED with budget_consumed and no automatic retry. Hard termination leaves STARTED/RUNNING evidence. Existing final result, partial or segment checkpoint blocks a fresh attempt; files and claims are not deleted or reset.

Checkpoint file and directory fsync complete before the next segment. Final output uses exclusive partial, no-overwrite hardlink publication and directory fsync before registry COMPLETED with output SHA. Failure preserves existing files.

prepare reads saved contracts/parent freezes, calls pure freeze_comparison and writes proposed bindings/NEXT_ECONOMIC_BATCH. reports and seal only assemble saved metadata. No loader, strategy replay, allocation, start or authorized gateway call occurs in assembler.

Guard now requires exact six unique symbols and complete coverage universe, exact two SR proposal labels, exact data/independent-capital changed axis and minimum two. It validates parent freeze equality, current code closure, all eligible children and unchanged child model/config/cost/cash/execution policies.
